TWO ELECTRIFIED SPHERES.
271
of the sphere $A$ will be those of the actual distribution of elec-
tricity. All the images will lie on the axis between the poles
and the centres of the spheres, and it will be observed that of
the four systems of images determined in Art. 172, only the third
and fourth exist in this case.
If we put
$$\begin{gathered}
k=\frac{\sqrt{a^{4}+b^{4}+c^{4}-2 b^{2} c^{2}-2 c^{2} a^{2}-2 a^{2} b^{2}}}{2 c} \\
\text { then } \quad \sinh a=-\frac{k}{a}, \quad \sinh \beta=\frac{k}{b}
\end{gathered}$$
The values of $\theta$ and $\phi$ for the centre of the sphere $A$ are
$$\theta=2 a, \quad \phi=0$$
Hence in the equations we must substitute $a$ or $-k \frac{1}{\sinh a}$
for $P, 2 a$ for $\theta$ and 0 for $\phi$, remembering that $P$ itself forms part of
the charge of $A$. We thus find for the coefficient of capacity of $A$
$$q_{a a}=k \sum_{s=0}^{s=\infty} \frac{1}{\sinh (8 \varpi-a)},$$
for the coefficient of induction of $A$ on $B$ or of $B$ on $A$
$$q_{a b}=-k \sum_{s=1}^{s=\infty} \frac{1}{\sinh 8 \omega} .$$
We might, in like manner, by supposing $B$ at potential unity
and $A$ at potential zero, determine the value of $q_{b b}$. We should
find, with our present notation,
$$q_{b b}=k \sum_{s=0}^{s=\infty} \frac{1}{\sinh (\beta+8 \omega)} .$$
To calculate these quantities in terms of $a$ and $b$, the radii of
the spheres, and of $c$ the distance between their centres, we
observe that if
$$K=\sqrt{a^{4}+b^{4}+c^{4}-2 b^{2} c^{2}-2 c^{2} a^{2}-2 a^{2} b^{2}}$$
we may write
$$\sinh a=-\frac{K}{2 a c}, \sinh \beta=\frac{K}{2 b c}, \sinh \varpi=\frac{K}{2 a b},$$
$\cosh \alpha=\frac{c^{2}+a^{2}-b^{2}}{2 c a}, \cosh \beta=\frac{c^{2}+b^{2}-a^{2}}{2 c b}, \cosh \varpi=\frac{c^{2}-a^{2}-b^{2}}{2 a b} ;$
and we may make use of
$$\begin{aligned}
& \sinh (a+\beta)=\sinh a \cosh \beta+\cosh a \sinh \beta \\
& \cosh (a+\beta)=\cosh a \cosh \beta+\sinh a \sinh \beta
\end{aligned}$$
